title: Ticket prices for NCT Wish's Big Dome concert announced
summary: The ticket prices for Japanese-Korean boy band NCT Wish's upcoming concert at the Araneta Coliseum were announced on Tuesday, with prices ranging from P3,500 to P13,500.
